title: Pure Gimmick Puppet

allow.Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force: The Rank-Up-Magic Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix searches and Puppet Parade sets: it ranks Number 40 or Number 15 up into their Number C forms.

summary: Gimmick Puppet cards with one Rank-Up-Magic and generic staples. The page's one-card combo ends on CXyz Gimmick Puppet Fanatix Machinix, which is Forbidden in the TCG, as is Gimmick Puppet Nightmare, so this list climbs into the legal Rank 8 and 9 Numbers instead. The 2024-25 Puppets lead. Gimmick Puppet Rouge Doll reveals a Gimmick Puppet Xyz to summon itself and a matching-Level Puppet from the Deck, and Little Soldiers mills a Puppet and copies its Level. Gimmick Puppet Fiendish Knight, the newest card, revives a Puppet or one of the opponent's monsters next to itself. Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix searches Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force and grants an extra Machine Normal Summon. Number 40 and Number C40 are Limited.
